author: CollinRugg
text:
Female judge sentences a Michigan woman to 100 *weekends* in jail for allegedly killing a 76-year-old with her car before fleeing the scene. 

32-year-old Stephanie Holt pleaded no contest for the hit and run of 76-year-old Mary Hulswit.

She was sentenced to 100 weekends in jail and 200 hours of community service.

How pathetic.
